# Kykar, Wind's Fury (M20). Flying is compiled (keywords).
# s2: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
#     event: Spellgorger Weird (B2b-noncreature-counter); token: Triplicate Spirits (B11-create-tokens) with count 1.
# s3: Sacrifice a Spirit: Add {R}.
#     cost: CostSacrifice CHOOSE you-control (Witch's Cauldron); tribal noun = SUBTYPE_EQ + TYPE_EQ Creature (guide);
#     effect: B3-add-mana-single ({T}: Add {R}.)
spirit = TokenSpec(
    name='Spirit',
    type_line='Creature — Spirit',
    types=('Creature',),
    subtypes=('Spirit',),
    power=QConst(value=1),
    toughness=QConst(value=1),
    keywords=(Keyword.FLYING,),
    abilities=(),
    colors=('W',),
)
cast_trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature')),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {'count': QConst(value=1), 'tokens': spirit}),
)
sac_for_red = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostSacrifice(
                target=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Spirit'),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'color': 'R', 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [cast_trigger, sac_for_red, *compiled]
